scope: Primary-source metadata, abstracts, and explicitly selected paper sections. No full-paper reading or replication is claimed.
final_citation_instruction: The root agent must reopen a source or its selected section before using these source reference IDs in a final web citation.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
sources.depth: Metadata and abstract; selected PDF discussion and Broader Impact, PDF pp. 9-10 / text lines 528-553. Not a full-paper review.
sources.verified_support: Retrieval supplies external information and provenance opportunities; the paper explicitly warns that external knowledge can be factually wrong or biased.
sources.transfer_limit: Its comparative NLP generation findings do not prove correctness, citation entailment, market causality, or a Project 50K error rate.

sources.title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
sources.depth: Metadata and abstract; selected sections 3.3-3.4, Appendix D-E and adjacent human-evaluation definitions. Selected text lines 292-399 and 1201-1257. Not a full-paper review.
sources.verified_support: Citation support, irrelevant citations, answer correctness, and answer coverage are separate evaluation dimensions. The paper describes an automatic partial-support limitation and shortcut answers with high citation scores but low coverage.
sources.transfer_limit: NLI entails a statement relative to supplied passages; it does not independently establish the passages' world truth. No benchmark percentage is transferred to Project 50K.

sources.title: SelfCheckGPT: Zero-Resource Black-Box Hallucination Detection for Generative Large Language Models

metadata.author_note: PDF supplies Mark J. F. Gales; Anthology metadata abbreviates to Mark Gales.

sources.depth: Metadata and abstract/PDF author header; selected sample-count and evaluator discussion plus Limitations on PDF p. 9, text lines 763-821. Not a full-paper review.
sources.verified_support: Sampling consistency is a detector studied on generated WikiBio biographies. The authors identify mixed factual/nonfactual sentences and computationally heavy prompt checking as limitations.
sources.transfer_limit: A same-model review is a fallible diagnostic, not independent source corroboration or probability calibration. Current Turkish market performance, latency, token usage, and provider prices were not measured.

sources.title: SAC3: Reliable Hallucination Detection in Black-Box Language Models via Semantic-aware Cross-check Consistency
sources.depth: Publisher metadata and abstract only, text lines 57-88. Full paper was not reviewed.
sources.verified_support: The abstract reports question-level and model-level failures of self-consistency alone, and motivates question perturbations and cross-model checking.
sources.transfer_limit: Abstract-level review does not establish detailed mechanisms, a project-specific cost/benefit, or that different models provide statistically independent errors.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
sources.depth: Publisher metadata and abstract only, text lines 8-24. Full paper and calibration experiments were not reviewed or replicated.
sources.verified_support: Calibration concerns how probability estimates correspond to correctness likelihood. The studied calibration methods concern classification models on image/document datasets.
sources.transfer_limit: The paper does not validate a weighted quality rubric or automatically turn the project's heuristic evidence score into a probability.

sources.title: On the Foundations of Noise-free Selective Classification
sources.depth: Publisher metadata and abstract only, text lines 30-35. No theorem or full-paper review is claimed.
sources.verified_support: Reject-option classification treats accuracy and coverage as a tradeoff.
sources.transfer_limit: The stated theory concerns noise-free models. It does not certify noisy evidence, market monitoring, model abstention, or any project risk bound.

sources.title: Causal inference in statistics: An overview
sources.depth: Author-hosted paper header, abstract, and selected introduction/sections 2.1-2.2, PDF pp. 1-5, text lines 0-24, 70-78 and 120-161. Not a full-paper review.
sources.verified_support: Associational observations alone do not establish a causal effect; causal claims require explicit assumptions and a target quantity.
sources.transfer_limit: No project causal model, identification argument, event-study design, or market effect estimate is supplied by this lab.
